name: Ningbo Energy Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ningbo Energy Group Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the power generation activities in China. It offers cogeneration, biomass power generation, pumped storage, integrated energy services, as well as involved in energy, environmental protection, and industry-related investment businesses. The company was formerly known as NINGBO THERMAL POWER CO.,LTD. and changed its name to Ningbo Energy Group Co.,Ltd. in December 2020. Ningbo Energy Group Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1994 and is based in Ningbo, China.
